$schema-note: Brand component catalog. Snippets use the b- prefixed classes from brand.css; brand-compat.css uses the same names without b-.

states.hover: One small step, --dur-fast. Never the only way to reveal something.
states.focus: The global :focus-visible ring (3px, accent, 2px offset), instant, keyboard only.
states.disabled: [disabled] or aria-disabled="true": muted, flat, no hover. aria-disabled stays focusable so the app can explain why on click.
states.loading: .busy plus aria-busy="true": spinner, repeat clicks blocked, width held.

components.name: Page frame
components.use: Every screen's main column. .b-page is Hints' 560px phone column; .wide is Workshop's list and form width; .full goes edge to edge. .b-read caps long text at 68ch.
components.snippet:

components.aria: Use one <main>. Tabs that switch views are links with aria-current="page"; tabs that switch panels use role="tablist" with aria-selected.
components.keyboard: Tab moves through tabs; the ring sits inside the tab.

components.name: Hero band
components.use: The deep garnet header band. Garnet in every app, whatever the accent. One per page, at the top.
components.snippet:
Alexis Davidson

Hints

components.aria: A <header> landmark. Text inside uses --hero-ink and --hero-muted; focus rings turn topaz.
components.keyboard: Add data-toggle-class="on-hero" to the theme.js tag so the toggle reads on the band.

components.name: Button

variants.use: The one main action on a screen. Solid accent.
Tinted secondary, for a group of actions.
Text-only actions in toolbars and lists.
The big full-width sticker call to action. One per screen.

components.snippet:
<button class="b-btn primary">Save</button>
<button class="b-btn">Cancel</button>
<button class="b-btn busy primary" aria-busy="true">Saving</button>
<button class="b-btn" aria-disabled="true">Publish</button>
components.aria: Use <button> for actions and <a> for navigation. Loading: add .busy and aria-busy="true". Disabled: prefer aria-disabled="true" (stays focusable) and explain why on click; use the disabled attribute only when there is nothing to explain.
components.keyboard: Enter and Space activate. Focus ring on Tab only.

components.name: Icon button
components.use: .b-iconbtn is round and outlined (Hints). .b-ibtn is the square, borderless toolbar button (Workshop).
components.snippet: <button class="b-iconbtn" aria-label="Add"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg></button>
components.aria: Always an aria-label. The svg gets aria-hidden="true".

components.name: Link button
components.use: A small underlined text action (Undo, Show all). Text-sized, with a full 44px hit area.
components.aria: A <button>, or an <a> when it navigates.

components.name: Card

variants.use: Topaz offset for the one that matters most.
Hairline, no offset, for dense screens.
Deep garnet with a topaz offset.

components.snippet:

components.aria: A tappable card is one <a> or <button>; do not nest other controls inside it.
components.keyboard: Tappable cards lift on hover and press flat.

components.name: List
components.use: Rows on hairlines inside one card. Lead each row with a .b-tile (category tint t0 to t3) or a .b-avatar.

components.aria: A real <ul>. Emoji in tiles are decoration: give the row text that says the same thing.
components.keyboard: Rows themselves are not focusable; their buttons are.

components.name: Stats and meter
components.aria: For a meter that means something, add role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax on the <i>.

components.name: Chips
components.use: Filters. Soft tint pills; the selected one turns pale accent with a ring and a check.
components.aria: Toggle chips use aria-pressed. Single-choice chips can use role="radiogroup" with aria-checked instead.
components.keyboard: Tab to each chip; Enter or Space toggles.

components.name: Tags

variants.use: Neutral emphasis in the app's accent.
Categories only: garnet, tourmaline, amethyst, sapphire. Never a status.

components.snippet: DoneDue soonHomev2.0.0
components.aria: Status tags carry a word, not just a color.

components.name: Field and input
components.use: Soft filled inputs: panel fill with a 3:1 edge at rest, white with an accent ring while typing. Works on input, select and textarea.
components.aria: Every input has a visible label. Errors: aria-invalid="true" plus a message linked with aria-describedby. Placeholders are hints, never the label.

components.name: Switch, checkbox, segmented
components.aria: Switch: role="switch" with aria-checked. Segmented: role="radiogroup" with role="radio" buttons.
components.keyboard: Switch: Space toggles. Segmented: arrow keys move the choice (the app wires this).

components.name: Notes and empty states
components.snippet:
Heads up: two items are due tomorrow.
Nothing here yet

Empty states say what goes here and offer the one next step.
components.aria: A note that appears after an action gets role="status" (or role="alert" for errors).

components.name: Menu and tooltip
components.aria: role="menu" with role="menuitem" buttons; the trigger has aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded. Tooltips repeat an aria-label and never hold the only copy of information (they hide on touch).
components.keyboard: Arrow keys move, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger (the app wires this).

components.name: Toast
components.snippet: Saved to your list
components.aria: role="status" (polite). Keep it up at least 4 seconds, longer with an Undo.
components.keyboard: Undo is a real button and keeps a 44px hit area.

components.name: Sheet
components.use: A <dialog>: slides up on phones with a topaz stripe; a centered sticker card on wider screens.
components.snippet: New idea
components.aria: Open with showModal() so focus is trapped and Escape closes it. Label it with aria-labelledby.
components.keyboard: Escape closes; focus returns to the trigger.

components.name: Theme toggle
components.use: theme.js adds it to the top right corner of every page. Never build your own.
components.aria: theme.js sets aria-label to the action ("Switch to dark mode").
